description:
We are The Defiants: intrepid minds drawn to the celestial and the unexplored. We ask for a tall ship and a star to steer her by, and an endless frontier upon which to test the limits of our ingenuity.

That spirit carries through in our pursuits: a taste for astronomy and engineering, a weakness for a well-told story, a passion for creating games, an eye for design, and a fondness for building software.
